course.title: Principles of Environmental Engineering
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Design a leach pit for both single and alternating twin off-set pit pour flush (12) latrine serving a family of 8 members having a life period of 3 years. The average waste water flow rate is about 10 Ipcd and the soil is sandy soil.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
